I couldn't find anything about centering a div with CSS in the FastAPI docs I have. That's a general CSS question, not a FastAPI one. The excerpts only mention CSS for the Swagger UI files used by the API docs.

For centering techniques, a CSS reference like MDN is a better place to look. Try searching for flexbox or grid alignment.

If your question is about styling FastAPI's docs UI, the docs do cover that partly. By default, those files are served from a CDN.[1] But it's possible to customize it, you can set a specific CDN, or serve the files yourself.[1] To do this, you pass a `swagger_css_url` to `get_swagger_ui_html`. That's the URL where the HTML for your Swagger UI docs can get the **CSS** file.[3]

```python
@app.get("/docs", include_in_schema=False)
async def custom_swagger_ui_html():
    return get_swagger_ui_html(
        openapi_url=app.openapi_url,
        title=app.title + " - Swagger UI",
        oauth2_redirect_url=app.swagger_ui_oauth2_redirect_url,
        swagger_js_url="/static/swagger-ui-bundle.js",
        swagger_css_url="/static/swagger-ui.css",
    )
```

More details: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/how-to/custom-docs-ui-assets/
